description.content: Search, view, and autocomplete electronic component products. Every product is a unique combination of manufacturer (`mfr`) and manufacturer part number (`mpn`), identified by a Cofactr ID (CPID). Product responses are shaped by the requested `schema` and can include specs, documents, compliance data, and market offers.
List products.

query.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
Whether to force re-ingestion from external sources. Overrides `external`.
Base64 encoded page token used for pagination.
Filters to apply for the search.
Search query. Its interpretation depends on `search_strategy`; that parameter documents the syntax for each strategy.

How long until offer data is considered stale: a duration string (e.g. "15m", "2h", "1d") or "inf" to never treat cached offer data as stale. Server default: 3 days. Only consulted when a refresh is performed (`external=true` or `force_refresh=true`).

Search strategy for interpreting `q`:
- `default`: general search across MPN, alt MPNs, SKU, manufacturer, classification, and description, with partial/autocomplete matching; results sorted by inventory descending.
- `mpn_exact`: `q` must exactly match one of the product's MPNs (including alternates).
- `mpn_exact_multi`: `q` is querystring-encoded (`mpn=A&mpn=B`, repeatable); matches products whose MPN exactly matches any of the given values.
- `mpn_exact_mfr`: `q` is querystring-encoded (`mpn=...&mfr=...`, repeatable); exact MPN match, optionally constrained to the given manufacturer(s).
- `mpn_sku_mfr`: tailored for BOM matching where `q` is an MPN optionally followed by a manufacturer; scores MPN/alt-MPN/SKU/manufacturer matches and sorts by inventory descending.

(Required) Response schema for the returned product(s). Public values: `product-v0`, `product-v1`, `product-offers-v0`, `product-offers-v1`. Prefer `product-offers-v1` for new integrations that need offers and structured spec quantities. Schemas are versioned, and older versions remain available. Additional bespoke schemas exist for specific customers by arrangement with the Cofactr team.

response.name: Products matching the search query or filters, shaped by the requested `schema` (example shows `product-v1`).

description.content: Execute multiple product queries in a single request. Each batch member is an operation against the products API expressed as a relative URL; members are fulfilled concurrently and returned in order.
